2005 Hyundai Atos Prime 1.1 GLS

  • Schedule Test Drive

This 2005 Hyundai Atos Prime 1.1 GLS in red is a compact, economical city car that has been cared for, with a partial service history to support its condition. The 1.1l petrol engine up front delivers 45 kW and 87 Nm, with average fuel consumption of about 6.2 l/100 km and an estimated range of around 565 km from the 35 litre tank, making it ideal for budget conscious daily commuting. With a claimed 0 to 100 km/h in 15.0 s and a top speed of 147 km/h, it offers practical performance for urban and suburban driving.

Inside, the GLS trim focuses on comfort and convenience, giving you a comfortable driving position and easy to use controls in a light, airy cabin. This Atos is a smart choice for first time buyers, students, or anyone needing reliable, low cost transport. While there is no active warranty, buyers can take confidence from its solid mechanical reputation and straightforward running costs. At this price point, well maintained Atos models tend to move quickly, so contact the seller soon to arrange a viewing or test drive.

Service History: Partial
